title: ChunkFreezer
description: Minecraft plugin that protects against crash machines.
body:
An extremely powerful plugin designed to protect your server from various types of crash machines and overloads. The plugin continuously monitors each chunk in real-time, detecting excessive entities, redstone contraptions, or other potentially harmful activity that could cause lag or crashes.

When a chunk exceeds safe limits, the plugin temporarily disables it, preventing further stress on the server while maintaining overall gameplay stability. Once the situation is resolved and the number of entities or active redstone components drops back to a safe level, the plugin automatically restores the chunk to its normal state.

This plugin ensures smooth gameplay, reduces server lag, and prevents malicious or accidental server crashes, making it an essential tool for server owners who want to maintain a stable and enjoyable experience for their players.

---

Features:
- Automatic Chunk Monitoring - Continuously scans every chunk to detect overloads caused by entities, redstone.
- Dynamic Chunk Protection - Temporarily disables overloaded chunks to prevent server crashes and lag spikes.
- Automatic Recovery - Re-enables chunks automatically once the number of entities or redstone components returns to safe levels.
- Customizable Thresholds - Configure limits for entities, redstone devices, and other parameters to suit your server’s needs.
- Real-Time Alerts - Notifies admins when a chunk is disabled or re-enabled, keeping you informed of server activity.
- Minimal Performance Impact - Optimized to run smoothly without adding significant overhead to your server.
- Easy Configuration - Simple and intuitive setup via configuration files.
